statute: Section 288B, Income-tax Act 1961, applied to the challan amount
notes: From the CA's answer to CA-04 (CA answers document, reviewed by the CA; CA details to follow): 'ignore paise first and then round the rupee amount to the nearest multiple of Rs 10; where the last rupee digit is 5 or more, round up to the next Rs 10, otherwise round down to the previous Rs 10.' The CA-03 answer puts this at the challan, not at each deduction. effective_from is the date this system applies the rule from (the rate table's, CA-05); the section's own commencement is earlier and is not recorded here. Whether it applies per challan line or to the total is CA-21. Nothing here is verified.
